verdict.rationale: Vapi's docs describe a dashboard Voice Library that lists every voice available to the organization, with browse, preview, and copy-voice-ID for use on an assistant. They also say voices can come from any Vapi-supported TTS provider, including custom voices set through the `voice` property, which covers both the library and multi-provider halves of the story. missing for 10: no named list or count of supported TTS providers or library size to show breadth, no detail on bring-your-own-provider credentials, no independent or hands-on corroboration of voice selection.
